messages.subject: Study site in Kalahari/Africa
parts:
Dear all,

This is just to inform you that we provide a field research station and
study site for anyone who wants to verify or do a study with distance
sampling methods in an African savannah ecosystem.

If there is interest, please contact me.
Best, Johanna.

*******************************************************************
BRinK - Biological Research in Kuzikus
Johanna Reinhard, MSc
